COPY_MANY_SCRIPT: root=$1; d=$2; shift 2; for s in "$@"; do case "$d/" in "$s"/*) printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; continue ;; esac;   r=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$s")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || { printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; continue; };   case "$r/" in "$root"/*|"$root"/) ;; *) printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; continue ;; esac;   b=$(basename -- "$s");   n=$b; e=;   case $b in .*) ;; *.*) n=${b%.*}; e=.${b##*.} ;; esac;   t=$d/$b; i=1;   while [ -e "$t" ] || [ -L "$t" ]; do t="$d/$n ($i)$e"; i=$((i+1)); done;   if cp -R -- "$s" "$t" 2>/dev/null; then printf "O\0%s\0" "$t"; else printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; fi; done
COPY_SCRIPT: s=$2; d=$3; r=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$s")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 13; case "$r/" in "$1"/*|"$1"/) ;; *) exit 13 ;; esac; b=$(basename -- "$s"); t=$d/$b; if [ -e "$t" ] || [ -L "$t" ]; then n=$b; e=;   case $b in .*) ;; *.*) n=${b%.*}; e=.${b##*.} ;; esac;   t="$d/$n (copy)$e"; fi; cp -R -- "$s" "$t" && printf "%s\0" "$t"
CREATE_DIR_SCRIPT: r=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$2")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 13; case "$r/" in "$1"/*|"$1"/) ;; *) exit 13 ;; esac; mkdir -p -- "$2"
CREATE_FILE_SCRIPT: r=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$2")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 13; case "$r/" in "$1"/*|"$1"/) ;; *) exit 13 ;; esac; set -C; : > "$2" 2>/dev/null || exit 1
DELETE_MANY_SCRIPT: root=$1; shift; for p in "$@"; do r=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$p")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || continue;   case "$r/" in "$root"/*|"$root"/) rm -rf -- "$p" ;; esac; done
MOVE_SCRIPT: root=$1; d=$2; shift 2; for s in "$@"; do case "$d/" in "$s"/*) printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; continue ;; esac;   r=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$s")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || { printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; continue; };   case "$r/" in "$root"/*|"$root"/) ;; *) printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; continue ;; esac;   b=$(basename -- "$s");   n=$b; e=;   case $b in .*) ;; *.*) n=${b%.*}; e=.${b##*.} ;; esac;   t=$d/$b; i=1;   while [ -e "$t" ] || [ -L "$t" ]; do t="$d/$n ($i)$e"; i=$((i+1)); done;   if mv -- "$s" "$t" 2>/dev/null; then printf "O\0%s\0" "$t"; else printf "E\0%s\0" "$s"; fi; done
POLL_MTIME_BSD_SCRIPT: for d in "$@"; do stat -f %m -- "$d" 2>/dev/null || echo x; done
POLL_MTIME_GNU_SCRIPT: for d in "$@"; do stat -c %Y -- "$d" 2>/dev/null || echo x; done
PROBE_SCRIPT: uname -s; printf "%s\n" "$HOME"; id -un; printf "%s\n" "${SHELL:-}"; if stat -c %Y . >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo gnu; else echo bsd; fi; if find . -maxdepth 0 -print0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo find0; else echo nofind0; fi; if command -v inotifywait >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo inotify; else echo -; fi; if command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo rg; else echo -; fi; if command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then tmux -V; else echo -; fi; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo apt; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo dnf; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo yum; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo apk; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo pacman; elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo zypper; elif command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo brew; else echo -; fi
READ_DIR_FALLBACK_SCRIPT: cd -- "$1" || exit 3; for e in */ .*/; do [ -e "$e" ] || [ -L "$e" ] || continue;   case "$e" in ./|../) continue ;; esac;   printf "%s\0" "${e%/}"; done; printf '\0'; for e in * .*; do [ -d "$e" ] && continue;   case "$e" in .|..) continue ;; esac;   { [ -e "$e" ] || [ -L "$e" ]; } || continue;   printf "%s\0" "$e"; done
READ_DIR_SCRIPT: cd -- "$1" || exit 3; find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -print0; printf '\0'; find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -type d -print0
TMUX_KILL_SESSION_SCRIPT: s=$1; [ -n "$s" ] && o="-L $s" || o=; tmux $o list-sessions -F "#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -- "$2" || exit 3; tmux $o kill-session -t "$2"
TMUX_LIST_SESSIONS_SCRIPT: s=$1; [ -n "$s" ] && o="-L $s" || o=; command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; tmux $o list-sessions -F "#{session_windows}	#{session_attached}	#{session_created}	#{session_activity}	#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | tr "\t" "\0"; printf '\n'; tmux $o list-panes -a -F "#{window_active}	#{pane_active}	#{pane_current_command}	#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | tr "\t" "\0"
TMUX_RENAME_SESSION_SCRIPT: s=$1; [ -n "$s" ] && o="-L $s" || o=; tmux $o list-sessions -F "#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -- "$2" || exit 3; tmux $o list-sessions -F "#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -- "$3" && exit 17; tmux $o rename-session -t "$2" -- "$3"
TMUX_SESSION_STATE_SCRIPT: s=$1; n=$2; [ -n "$s" ] && o="-L $s" || o=; tmux $o display-message -p -t "$n" "#{pane_current_path}|#{pane_path}|#{pane_current_command}" 2>/dev/null
UPLOAD_PASTE_IMAGE_SCRIPT: umask 077; t="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"; d="${t%/}/etty-paste"; mkdir -p -- "$d" || exit 1; find "$d" -type f -mmin +1440 -exec rm -f {} + 2>/dev/null; cat > "$d/$1" || exit 1; printf %s "$d/$1"
